items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: He was supposed to be the trumpet player that Louis Armstrong was scared of... Now he got killed before I was born but everybody being from Crowley, everybody used to talk about him

ctx.x: But as far as traditional music is concerned I didn’t really get into that. I mean they had people playing that but I never did buy it. And then I guess what I was a little — see I was in southwest Louisiana. Now they had bands from down there. Have you ever heard of a trumpet player named Evan Thomas?
